fields.description: Default source for Material Requests and Material Issues (the RM Store).
fields.label: Main Warehouse

fields.description: The shop floor. Material Issues move stock here; Material Returns move it back out.
fields.label: WIP Warehouse

fields.description: Never counted as available stock. Rejected, Quarantine, QC Sample, Control Sample and QC Hold warehouses, and the WIP warehouse, are always left out anyway.
fields.label: Excluded Warehouses

fields.description: When set, merging sub orders onto one machine run is refused above the machine Max Capacity.
fields.label: Block merges above machine Max Capacity

fields.description: KG of finished product one BOM batch makes. Total Batches = Production Quantity (KG) / this; each material's Total Required Qty = its BOM qty x Total Batches.
fields.label: Standard Batch Size (KG)

fields.description: Where approved baked bulk (KG) is kept for Filling. Blank = the WIP Warehouse.
fields.label: Baked WIP Warehouse

fields.description: Filled FG lands here and stays on hold until Final QC clears the batch.
fields.label: FG Hold Warehouse

fields.description: QC-rejected baked bulk and FG are moved here.
fields.label: Rejected Warehouse

fields.description: Filling wastage above this % of the run weight needs Production Manager approval.
fields.label: Filling Wastage Tolerance (%)

fields.description: An Inventory Adjustment deducting more than this many KG needs Plant Head approval.
fields.label: Adjustment Approval Threshold (KG)
